Nuage Patisserie and Cafe, Indiranagar

Nuage Pâtisserie & Café is a beautiful lcafé tucked away in the quiet, …

This charming cafe serves flawless coffee and exceptional pastries. The real standout is the cheesecake—truly elite, perfectly creamy, and unforgettable. A beautiful space for an elevated daily ritual.
Food was good. Loved the English breakfast set. Ambience was good. It was clean. Service was good. Might go again! Prices have slightly increased too.
